schema:
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, budget REAL NULL, headcount REAL NULL);
CREATE TABLE evaluations (eval_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, total_tested INTEGER NOT NULL, passed_high INTEGER NULL, FOREIGN KEY (eval_id) REFERENCES departments (dept_id));
correct_query: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.budget AS REAL) / T1.headcount) FROM departments AS T1 INNER JOIN evaluations AS T2 ON T1.dept_id = T2.eval_id WHERE CAST(T2.passed_high AS REAL) / T2.total_tested > 0.3

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces real ratio comparison CAST(passed_high AS REAL) / total_tested > 0.3 with truncating integer percentage division passed_high * 100 / total_tested > 30
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT MAX(CAST(T2.budget AS REAL) / T2.headcount) AS highest_budget_per_head FROM evaluations AS T1 INNER JOIN departments AS T2 ON T1.eval_id = T2.dept_id WHERE T1.passed_high * 100 / T1.total_tested > 30 AND NOT T2.headcount IS NULL AND NOT T2.budget IS NULL

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Relaxes strict inequality > 0.3 to >= 0.3 on the division ratio predicate
